memory_objects.canonical_definition: An ionic solid consists of cations and anions arranged in an extended lattice held together by electrostatic attractions.
memory_objects.story_hint: alternating charged tiles continuing through the entire floor

memory_objects.canonical_definition: A molecular solid consists of discrete molecules held together in the solid by intermolecular forces.
memory_objects.story_hint: separate molecule cases touching only through weaker links

memory_objects.canonical_definition: A Lewis electron-dot structure represents valence electrons and bonding connections using element symbols, lines, and dots.
memory_objects.story_hint: the drafting board shows symbols, bond lines, and lone-pair dots

memory_objects.canonical_definition: Formal charge assigns bonding electrons equally between bonded atoms and compares the assigned electrons with the atom's valence-electron count.
memory_objects.story_hint: the electron ledger assigns half of each bonding pair to each bonded atom
